config_toml:
default_permissions="native-task"
web_search="disabled"
[permissions.native-task]
filesystem={":root"="deny", ":minimal"="read", "/testbed"="write", "/workspace/scratch"="write", "/home/native/.agents/skills"="read", "/native"="read", "/usr"="read", "/lib"="read", "/bin"="read", "/etc"="read", "/opt"="read", "/state"="deny"}
network.enabled=false
[features]
memories=false
[shell_environment_policy]
inherit="none"
set={PATH="/opt/conda/envs/testbed/bin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/bin:/bin",HOME="/home/native",TMPDIR="/workspace/scratch",PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE="1"}

[projects."/testbed"]
trust_level = "trusted"
credential_source: authorized ChatGPT auth file copied privately, not published
